info.title: SIH 2026 Food Traceability - Application Service
info.description: SIH 2026 Developer 3 Application / Backend Microservice - Handles Auth/RBAC, Public APIs, Workflow Orchestration, QR Resolution, Feedback Accountability, Risk Propagator & Recall Actions.

post.description: Authenticate actor and return JWT bearer access token.

get.description: Retrieve current authenticated actor identity and role context.

post.description: Create and register a new food product definition.

get.description: Retrieve product definition by product ID.

post.description: Create and register a new traceable product batch.
Validate a batch state through the authorized validation workflow (P0 Milestone).
Transfer batch custody to another supply-chain organization.

get.description: Retrieve batch details and current lifecycle state.

post.description: Create individual sellable/traceable physical unit derived from a batch.

get.description: Retrieve details of a specific unit by unit ID.
Retrieve direct parent batches of a given batch.

schema.title: Response Get Parents Api V1 Lineage  Batch Id  Parents Get

get.description: Retrieve direct child batches derived from a given batch.

schema.title: Response Get Children Api V1 Lineage  Batch Id  Children Get

get.description: Retrieve complete graph lineage (parents + children) for a batch.

schema.title: Response Get Full Lineage Api V1 Lineage  Batch Id  Get

post.description: Resolve an outer public QR code reference, record audit scan, and return trace history.
Verify an inner concealed authenticity credential without altering product custody.
Upload lab reports, certificates, or feedback attachments off-chain to IPFS.

schema.title: Response Upload Evidence Api V1 Evidence Upload Post

get.description: Retrieve metadata and verification info for an IPFS evidence CID.

schema.title: Response Get Evidence Metadata Api V1 Evidence  Cid  Get

post.description: Submit consumer feedback / issue report for a product batch or unit.

get.description: Retrieve details of a registered incident.

post.description: Run bidirectional Risk Propagator logic over lineage graph to calculate affected scopes.
Block a batch from downstream distribution or processing.

schema.title: Response Block Batch Api V1 Recall Block Post

post.description: Issue an official targeted recall action across calculated affected batch scopes.

get.description: Retrieve high-level supply chain status metrics across processing, transport, and retail.

schema.title: Response Get Supply Chain Overview Api V1 Dashboard Supply Chain Overview Get

get.description: Retrieve operational batch tracking dashboard view.

schema.title: Response Get Batch Dashboard Api V1 Dashboard Batches Get

get.description: Retrieve incident investigation and escalation dashboard view.

schema.title: Response Get Incident Dashboard Api V1 Dashboard Incidents Get

get.description: Retrieve immutable audit trail log of stakeholder and consumer interactions.

schema.title: Response Get Audit Trail Api V1 Audit Trail Get
